title: Run a file or REPL
description: The runner reads a Mini file when requested, otherwise starts the interactive loop.

steps.description: run_file reads source from a path, reports a missing file, then calls run_source and reports Mini errors.
main creates the built-in global environment and interpreter, then defines the optional --file argument.
A supplied file path runs through run_file. Without one, main starts repl.
The module calls main only when it is executed as the program.
